description: Create a meter once (POST /api/v1/meters). aggregation: sum (add up value, e.g. tokens), count (number of events, e.g. tool calls) or unique_count (distinct unique_value, e.g. active users). Re-creating an existing key returns meter_exists (harmless). Free plan: 3 meters. Needs your API key.

stripe_event_name.description: Optional Stripe Billing Meter event_name for Stripe push (Pro/Ultra).
